title: AI-Based Transcription in Pediatrics: Evaluation of an AI-Based Transcription Tool for Doctor-Parent-Child Consultations in Pediatrics
summary: Medical documentation in healthcare is often time-consuming. The aim of this study is therefore to investigate the use of an AI-based system to support medical documentation in pediatrics, in order to determine how such a system affects clinical workflows and the interaction between the physician, the child, and the parents. During the consultation between the parents, the child, and the physician, the conversation is recorded using a technical AI system and automatically converted into written text. This text serves as medical documentation and is reviewed and approved by the treating physician. Additionally, data on perceptions of the system is collected via questionnaires.

interventions.name: After informed consent is obtained, the medical history interview between the physician, the legal guardians, and the child is recorded using an AI system and automatically transcribed into written text. This text serves as part of the medical record and is reviewed and approved by the treating phys

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Consent from the parents or legal guardians 
Consent from the participating physicians 
Consent from the child, provided the child has the age- and developmentally appropriate ability to understand information presented in a child-friendly manner
Exclusion criteria:
Acute and emergency situations
Discussions involving highly sensitive topics
Rejection by the child
